source_refs.note: Roman Urdu explanation of Hubble's law and remote sensing (PDF 176-178).

blocks.text: Edwin Hubble ne yeh dikha kar jadeed cosmology ki bunyaad rakhi ke kehkashanein zameen se door ja rahi hain aur un ki velocity faasle ke saath barhti hai: kehkashan jitni door, utni tezi se door jati nazar aati hai.

blocks.title: Hubble ka qanoon
blocks.text: Kehkashan ki door jane ki velocity v zameen se us ke faasle d ke barah-e-raast mutanasib hai: v = Ho d (21.5), jahan Ho Hubble ka constant, taqreeban 2.3 x 10^-18 s^-1, hai.

Fig 21.6 Hubble ke qanoon ko kehkashaon ke redshift (door jane ki velocity) aur zameen se un ke faasle ke darmiyan seedhi lakeer ke talluq ki shakal mein dikhati hai; is ki dhalwan Hubble constant hai, jo kainat ke phailne ki sharah napta hai. Tamam kehkashanein aik doosre se door ja rahi hain, aur kisi aur kehkashan mein dekhne wala bhi yahi dekhega, kyunke khud khala khinch rahi hai.

blocks.alt: Graph: khara mehwar Recession velocity, leta mehwar Distance. Bohat se nuqte origin se guzarti seedhi lakeer ke qareeb hain, beech mein ghane.
blocks.caption: Figure 21.6: Hubble ke qanoon ki graph ki shakal (kitab ki Figure 21.6 ke mutabiq asal khaaka).

blocks.text: Scientists aksar phoolte guhbare (balloon) ka model use karte hain (Fig 21.7): guhbare ki satah par nuqte kehkashanein aur us ki khaal space-time hai. Guhbara phoolne par har nuqta baqi tamam nuqton ko door jata 'dekhta' hai. Yun kainat mein ham kaheen bhi hon, kehkashanein door jati nazar aayengi: phailao har jagah ho raha hai aur koi khaas markaz nahi; zameen kainat ke markaz par nahi.

blocks.alt: Teen gehre rang ke guhbare, chhote se bare; har aik par lakeerein aur wahi roshan nuqte usi jagah; bare guhbare par nuqte aik doosre se zyada door.
blocks.caption: Figure 21.7: phailti kainat ki misal: guhbara phoolne par nuqte door hote hain (kitab ki Figure 21.7 ke mutabiq asal khaaka).

blocks.text: Kyunke kainat ab phail rahi hai, ham tasawwur mein waqt ulta chala sakte hain. Is ka matlab hai ke (i) maazi mein kehkashanein zyada qareeb thin, aur (ii) aur peeche, tamam maddah bohat chhoti, ghani aur garam halat mein daba hua tha. Yeh khayal Big Bang theory ki bunyaad hai, jo kehti hai ke kainat taqreeban 13.8 arab saal pehle aik ibtidai singularity se shuru hui aur tab se phail rahi hai. Hubble ka qanoon mazboot mushahidati saboot deta hai ke kainat saakin nahi balke phail rahi hai, aur Big Bang model ke kaleedi sutoonon mein se hai. Fig 21.8 Big Bang se ab tak kainat ki taqreebi timeline dikhati hai.

blocks.alt: Neeche Big Bang se oopar phailta makhroot (cone). Marahil aur waqt: Big Bang, 0; Recombination Era, 380 hazaar saal; First stars appear, 30 crore saal; Early galaxies, 1 arab saal; Modern galaxies (Acceleration), Today. Chhote labels: First structure formation; Expanding proto-clusters; Current Era: Lambda-CDM, aur kehkashaon ke door hone ke teer.
blocks.caption: Figure 21.8: Big Bang se aaj tak kainat ke irtiqa ki taqreebi timeline (kitab ki Figure 21.8 ke mutabiq asal khaaka).

blocks.title: Diagram ko samjhein
blocks.text: Neeche se oopar waqt barhta hai aur makhroot ki chaurai kainat ke phailao ko dikhati hai. Pehle atoms (Recombination Era, 380 hazaar saal), phir pehle sitare (30 crore saal), phir kehkashanein (1 arab saal), aur aaj taqreeban 13.8 arab saal baad phailao tez ho raha hai (Acceleration). Surkh teer kehkashaon ke darmiyan barhte faasle dikhate hain.

blocks.title: Kya aap jante hain?
blocks.text: Hubble ki daryaft se pehle zyada tar scientists samajhte the ke kainat saakin hai. Hubble ke qanoon ne yeh khayal ulat diya, yeh batate hue ke kainat ki ibtida thi, aur Big Bang theory tak le gaya.

Satellite remote sensing madar mein ghoomte khalai jahazon par lage sensors se khala se zameen ke mahol ki nigrani aur tajziya karti hai. Is se scientists jangalat ki katai, mausami tabdeeli, samandar ke darja hararat aur fiza ki banawat dekh sakte hain. Zameeni tareeqon ke bar-aks yeh wasee jughrafiyai ihata aur waqt ke saath bar bar mushahida deti hai, jis se mahol ki taveel nigrani mumkin hoti hai (Fig 21.9).

blocks.alt: Sooraj (Energy source) zameen (Target) par chamakta hai. Zameen se shuaein satellite (Sensor) tak jati hain, raaste mein aik nuqte par har taraf bikharti (scattering) hain. Satellite signals dish aur imaraton (Processing station) ko bhejta hai; mota teer data computer par baithe shakhs (Analysis) tak aur phir rangeen naqshe wale laptop (Application) tak le jata hai.
blocks.caption: Figure 21.9: remote sensing ka amal (kitab ki Figure 21.9 ke mutabiq asal khaaka).

blocks.title: Diagram ko samjhein
blocks.text: Figure ki tarteeb neeche di gayi chhe qadamon jaisi hai: (1) Sooraj source hai, (2) raaste mein fiza shua ko bikherti hai (bikharte teer), (3) shua zameen (target) se takrati hai, (4) satellite ka sensor lautne wali shua record karta hai, (5) data processing station ko bheja jata hai, (6) phir analysis aur application.

items: Source aur roshni: pehla juz source hai jo electromagnetic shuaon se target ko roshan karta hai (aam taur par Sooraj).
Fiza: raaste mein shua fiza se bikharne, inikas waghera ke zariye amal karti hai.
Target se amal: shua target se amal karti hai; yeh amal target aur shua ki khasiyaton par munhasir hai.
Sensor se record: kharij ya mun'akis shua door (target se na chhoota) sensor record karta hai.
Tarseel aur wusool: record data receiving station ko bheja aur tasaveer jaisi qabil-e-istemal shakal mein badla jata hai.
Tashreeh aur tajziya: processed tasveer se maloomat hasil karne ke liye electronic ya digital tareeqe se tashreeh ki jati hai.

blocks.prompt: Aik kehkashan ham se bohat tezi se door ja rahi hai. Hubble ke qanoon ke mutabiq yeh us ke faasle ke bare mein kya batata hai?
blocks.explanation: Woh bohat door hai, kyunke v = Ho d: zyada door jane ki velocity ka matlab zyada faasla.

blocks.prompt: Ho = 2.3 x 10^-18 s^-1 le kar kainat ki umar 1/Ho ke taur par andaza lagayein.
blocks.explanation: 1/Ho = 4.3 x 10^17 s, jo taqreeban 1.4 x 10^10 saal (14 arab saal) hai, maqbool 13.8 arab saal ke qareeb.

items: Hubble ka qanoon v = Ho d; Ho taqreeban 2.3 x 10^-18 s^-1.
Guhbara model: har jagah phailao, koi markaz nahi.
Big Bang taqreeban 13.8 arab saal pehle; remote sensing chhe qadam.
